parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-4-8', max_tokens: 4096, thinking: { type: 'adaptive' }, system: $json.system, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.user }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ text: $json.script, model_id: $('Select the DJ').first().json.profile.ttsModel }, $('Select the DJ').first().json.profile.voiceSettings ? { voice_settings: $('Select the DJ').first().json.profile.voiceSettings } : {})) }}

parameters.command: =V="{{ $('Pick a bed').first().json.voiceFile }}"; B="{{ $('Pick a bed').first().json.bedFile }}"; O="{{ $('Pick a bed').first().json.outFile }}"; DOMIX="{{ $('Pick a bed').first().json.doMix }}"; FF=/home/node/.n8n/bin/ffmpeg; FP=/home/node/.n8n/bin/ffprobe; if [ "$DOMIX" = "true" ] && [ -s "$B" ]; then D=$($FP -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$V"); T=$(awk "BEGIN{print $D+4.0}"); FO=$(awk "BEGIN{print $D+1.8}"); $FF -y -i "$V" -i "$B" -filter_complex "[0:a]adelay=1500|1500,apad=pad_dur=2.5,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo,asplit=2[v1][v2];[1:a]aloop=loop=-1:size=2e9,atrim=0:$T,volume=0.32,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo[b];[b][v1]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.02:ratio=12:attack=25:release=500[duck];[duck][v2]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:normalize=0,afade=t=in:d=1.2,afade=t=out:st=$FO:d=2.2" -codec:a libmp3lame -b:a 160k "$O" >/tmp/kazm-mix.log 2>&1 && echo MIXED || { echo MIXFAIL; tail -3 /tmp/kazm-mix.log; cp "$V" "$O"; }; else cp "$V" "$O"; echo DRY; fi; rm -f "$B"
